source='''def transform(grid):
    """Color the empty tail after any horizontal row segment with red (1)."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    for row in out:
        occupied = [i for i, value in enumerate(row) if value != bg]
        if occupied:
            for i in range(max(occupied) + 1, len(row)):
                row[i] = 1
    return out
'''
file=program_dir/'task-21780765.py'
file.write_text(source)
